Alice (FinOps): Quick sync re: delayed batch replay -> ~+12% token variance across 4 customers. Need explicit owners for: ingest fix, ledger reconcile/invoice reissue, recurrence detection, and customer comms.
Ben (Eng): I can own the ingest fix. Plan: patch + staging smoke today, prod backfill tomorrow. Ill run a quick validation query and post results here.
Carol (Metering): Ill take recurrence detection and alerting. Propose: P1 (>=10% in 1h) -> page; P2 (>=5% in 24h) -> slack. Add short-term guard: require 2 consecutive buckets OR >5000 token delta to reduce noise.
Dilip (SRE): Ill own ledger reconcile and the invoice reissue playbook (include rollback). Need the impacted customer CSV in FIN-448 to script pro-rated credits.
Alice (FinOps): CSV uploaded to FIN-448. Finance will draft customer templates after the dry-run.
metering-bot: Invoice Reissue Job queued job_id=jr-20240501-88 status=queued (FIN-448).
Ben (Eng): Staging smoke passed; root cause looks like two shard windows reprocessed. Logs show ingest_worker_13 processed 42k events, 0 errors. Ill also add a late-batch latency metric to reduce recurrence.
Carol (Metering): Detection rule PR opened: github.com/redwood/meters/pull/421. Adding a notebook with examples and dashboards.
Dilip (SRE): Draft reconcile script at //ops/reconcile/reissue_dryrun.sh. Dry-run scheduled Mon 10:00 UTC; will report back here. If dry-run passes Ill request a production window Wed.
Alice (FinOps): Recap: Ben - patch + staging smoke (today) and prod backfill (tomorrow). Carol - detection rules + dashboards (Fri AM). Dilip - reconcile script + dry-run (Mon 10:00 UTC) and playbook update (next Tue). Post status updates here; Ill mark FIN-448 as "postmortem actions" when closed. :thumbsup:
